remarks: Conveniently located in the Glenbrook section of Stamford close to Downtown. Bright and spacious one bedroom, one bathroom apartment on the 6th floor offers 835 sq.ft. of living space. Living Room and Primary bedroom with sliders to balcony. Updated kitchen and bathroom. Luxury Vinyl flooring. Tile floor in the kitchen. Kitchen has breakfast bar and granite counter top. Rent includes natural gas baseboard heat up to 55 degrees, hot water and one reserved parking space (#59). Extra electric baseboard heating in unit. Building has elevator. Must have 600+ Fico score. No pets.
